commit.message:
feat(telemetry): agent-centric live dashboard, cost demoted to optional

Rebuild the token-ledger dashboard around the dimensions that matter
for multi-agent pipelines:

- Live updates: poll /_telemetry/data every 10s (skipped while the tab
  is hidden; in-flight fetches never overlap).
- Daily usage stacked per agent (top-5 by window tokens, rest folded
  into 'Other' in SQL) — the provider-stacked chart is gone: mid-pipeline
  upstreams all detect as one profile and carry no signal.
- Top models re-ranked by tokens consumed; cache reads added to
  tooltips and tables.
- Cache economics without pricing: cache-read sums in totals/agents and
  a per-agent cache hit % (cache_read over total input).
- Cost appears only when a pricing row exists in the window (tile,
  chart, and columns all conditional); pricing mentions removed from
  the footer.

Fixes caught in review: daily-agents CTE uses the window predicate
twice and passes its parameter twice; dashboard marker test updated
for the new footer.
